verdict.rationale: Figma Make is built around an in-product AI agent. Users delegate work through chat prompts, can run several chats at once while one is still working, can annotate the preview to give the agent instructions for specific elements, and can have it draft an editable plan before generation. A community commenter confirms the AI generates the React app itself. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of how reliably the agent completes multi-step delegated tasks end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: You can run more than one chat at the same time in a single Make file, so you can start a new change while another chat is still working.
